id_to_scss_variable.rule: Unless options.variable is set (unused in 4.0.1 UI JSON), the setting id is the SCSS injection key in Core::process_main_variables().
id_to_scss_variable.cssVariable_field: Dashboard live-preview CSS custom property name (cssVariable ?? `--${id}` in dashboard bundle). Often differs from --{id}; sometimes a bare CSS property name for contextual previews.

globals.handoff: F01→F02/F03: calculationType clamp/simple-clamp/simple-scale formulas belong to F02/F03; F01 records which settings feed each group.
